sanskrit: ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhur eva ca na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaś cyavanti te
english: For I am the enjoyer and the lord of all sacrifices; but men do not truly know me, and therefore they fall away.

sanskrit: yānti devavratā devān pitṝn yānti pitṛvratāḥ bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino 'pi mām
english: Those vowed to the gods go to the gods; those vowed to the ancestors go to the ancestors; the worshippers of spirits go to the spirits; but those who sacrifice to me come to me.

sanskrit: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati tad ahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtam aśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
english: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water—that offering, presented with devotion by the pure of heart, I accept and partake of.

sanskrit: yat karoṣi yad aśnāsi yaj juhoṣi dadāsi yat yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣva madarpaṇam
english: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you perform—do that, O son of Kuntī, as an offering to me.

sanskrit: śubhāśubhaphalair evaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣyasi
english: Thus you shall be freed from the bonds of action that bear fruits good and ill; with your self yoked to the discipline of renunciation, liberated, you shall come to me.

sanskrit: samo 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo 'sti na priyaḥ ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpy aham
english: I am the same toward all beings; to me none is hateful and none is dear. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I too am in them.

sanskrit: api cet sudurācāro bhajate mām ananyabhāk sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ
english: Even if a man of the most evil conduct worships me with undivided devotion, he is to be reckoned righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

sanskrit: kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
english: Swiftly he becomes righteous of soul and attains lasting peace. Know this for certain, O son of Kuntī: my devotee never perishes.

sanskrit: māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās te 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
english: For taking refuge in me, O Pārtha, even those of sinful birth—women, vaiśyas, and śūdras alike—they too attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit: kiṃ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayas tathā anityam asukhaṃ lokam imaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
english: How much more, then, the holy brāhmaṇas and devout royal sages! Having come into this impermanent and joyless world, worship me.

sanskrit: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru mām evaiṣyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
english: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, sacrifice to me, bow down to me; having thus yoked your self with me as your highest goal, you shall come to me alone.

sanskrit: śrībhagavān uvāca bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ yat te 'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
english: The Blessed Lord said: Once more, O mighty-armed, hear my supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who delight in me, out of desire for your good.

sanskrit: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ aham ādir hi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know my origin, for I am in every way the source of the gods and the great sages.

sanskrit: yo mām ajam anādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram asaṃmūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
english: Whoever knows me as unborn and without beginning, the great lord of the worlds, he, undeluded among mortals, is freed from all sins.

sanskrit: buddhir jñānam asaṃmohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo 'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayam eva ca
english: Understanding, knowledge, freedom from delusion, patience, truth, self-restraint, tranquility, pleasure, pain, being, non-being, fear, and fearlessness—

sanskrit: ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭis tapo dānaṃ yaśo 'yaśaḥ bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
english: non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame, and infamy—these manifold states of beings arise from me alone.

sanskrit: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavas tathā madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
english: The seven great sages of old, and likewise the four Manus, sharing in my nature, were born of my mind; from them came these creatures of the world.

sanskrit: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ so 'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: Whoever truly knows this manifest power and the yoga of mine is united with me through unshakable yoga; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
english: I am the source of all; from me everything proceeds. Knowing this, the wise, endowed with feeling, worship me.

sanskrit: maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam kathayantaś ca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
english: With their thoughts fixed on me, their lives surrendered to me, enlightening one another and ever speaking of me, they are content and they rejoice.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena mām upayānti te
english: To those who are ever steadfast and worship me with love, I grant that yoga of understanding by which they come to me.

sanskrit: teṣām evānukampārtham aham ajñānajaṃ tamaḥ nāśayāmy ātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
english: Out of compassion for them alone, dwelling within their being, I destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyam ādidevam ajaṃ vibhum
english: Arjuna said: You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier; the eternal, divine Spirit, the primal god, unborn and all-pervading.

sanskrit: āhus tvām ṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣir nāradas tathā asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
english: So all the seers proclaim you—the divine sage Nārada, and Asita Devala, and Vyāsa; and you yourself declare it to me.

sanskrit: sarvam etad ṛtaṃ manye yan māṃ vadasi keśava na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṃ vidur devā na dānavāḥ
english: All that you tell me I hold to be true, O Keśava; for neither the gods nor the dānavas know your manifestation, O Blessed One.

sanskrit: svayam evātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
english: You alone know yourself by yourself, O supreme Spirit, source of beings, lord of beings, god of gods, master of the world.

sanskrit: vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa divyā hy ātmavibhūtayaḥ yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṃs tvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
english: You alone are fit to declare in full your divine self-manifestations, by which manifest powers you stand pervading these worlds.

sanskrit: kathaṃ vidyām ahaṃ yogiṃs tvāṃ sadā paricintayan keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo 'si bhagavan mayā
english: How may I know you, O master of yoga, by meditating on you constantly? In what various forms, O Blessed One, are you to be contemplated by me?

sanskrit: vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptir hi śṛṇvato nāsti me 'mṛtam
english: Tell me again in detail of your yoga and your manifest power, O Janārdana; for as I listen there is no satiety in me for this nectar.

sanskrit: śrībhagavān uvāca hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hy ātmavibhūtayaḥ prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāsty anto vistarasya me
english: The Blessed Lord said: Come, I shall declare to you my divine self-manifestations—but only the chief of them, O best of the Kurus, for there is no end to my extent.

sanskrit: aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ aham ādiś ca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānām anta eva ca
english: I am the Self, O Guḍākeśa, seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the very end of all beings.

sanskrit: ādityānām ahaṃ viṣṇur jyotiṣāṃ ravir aṃśumān marīcir marutām asmi nakṣatrāṇām ahaṃ śaśī
english: Among the Ādityas I am Viṣṇu; among lights, the radiant sun; among the Maruts I am Marīci; among the lunar mansions I am the moon.

sanskrit: vedānāṃ sāmavedo 'smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ indriyāṇāṃ manaś cāsmi bhūtānām asmi cetanā
english: Among the Vedas I am the Sāmaveda; among the gods I am Vāsava; among the senses I am the mind; in beings I am consciousness.

sanskrit: rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraś cāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām vasūnāṃ pāvakaś cāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇām aham
english: Among the Rudras I am Śaṃkara; among the yakṣas and rākṣasas, the lord of wealth; among the Vasus I am fire; among the peaks I am Meru.

sanskrit: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim senānīnām ahaṃ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
english: Among priests know me to be their chief, Bṛhaspati, O Pārtha; among commanders of armies I am Skanda; among waters I am the ocean.

sanskrit: maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgur ahaṃ girām asmy ekam akṣaram yajñānāṃ japayajño 'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
english: Among the great sages I am Bhṛgu; among utterances I am the single syllable Oṃ; among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of muttered prayer; among the immovable, the Himālaya.

sanskrit: aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
english: Among all trees I am the aśvattha; among the divine sages, Nārada; among the gandharvas, Citraratha; among the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

sanskrit: uccaiḥśravasam aśvānāṃ viddhi mām amṛtodbhavam airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
english: Among horses know me to be Uccaiḥśravas, born of the nectar; among lordly elephants, Airāvata; and among men, the king.

sanskrit: āyudhānām ahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk prajanaś cāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
english: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am Kāmadhuk, the wish-granting cow; I am Kandarpa, the begetter; among serpents I am Vāsuki.

sanskrit: anantaś cāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasām aham pitṝṇām aryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatām aham
english: Among the nāgas I am Ananta; among the dwellers in the waters I am Varuṇa; among the ancestors I am Aryaman; among those who govern I am Yama.

sanskrit: prahlādaś cāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatām aham mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro 'haṃ vainateyaś ca pakṣiṇām
english: Among the daityas I am Prahlāda; among reckoners I am Time; among beasts I am the king of beasts, the lion; and among birds I am Vainateya, Garuḍa.

sanskrit: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtām aham jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraś cāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī
english: Among purifiers I am the wind; among bearers of weapons I am Rāma; among fishes I am the makara; among flowing rivers I am the Jāhnavī, the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit: sargāṇām ādir antaś ca madhyaṃ caivāham arjuna adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatām aham
english: Of creations I am the beginning, the end, and the middle as well, O Arjuna; among sciences I am the science of the supreme Self; among those who debate, I am their reasoned argument.

sanskrit: akṣarāṇām akāro 'smi dvaṃdvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca aham evākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
english: Among letters I am the letter A; among compounds I am the copulative dvandva. I alone am imperishable Time; I am the Sustainer facing in every direction.

sanskrit: mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaś cāham udbhavaś ca bhaviṣyatām kīrtiḥ śrīr vāk ca nārīṇāṃ smṛtir medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
english: I am all-seizing Death, and the origin of things yet to be; and among feminine powers I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, constancy, and patience.

sanskrit: bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasām aham māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo 'ham ṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
english: Among the Sāman hymns I am the Bṛhatsāman; among meters I am the Gāyatrī; among months I am Mārgaśīrṣa; among seasons I am the flower-bearing spring.

sanskrit: dyūtaṃ chalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham jayo 'smi vyavasāyo 'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatām aham
english: Among the deceitful I am the gambling of dice; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory, I am resolve; I am the goodness of the good.

sanskrit: vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo 'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ munīnām apy ahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ
english: Among the Vṛṣṇis I am Vāsudeva; among the Pāṇḍavas, Dhanaṃjaya; among sages I am Vyāsa; among seers I am Uśanā the poet.

sanskrit: daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣatām maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatām aham
english: Among those who chastise I am the rod; among those who seek victory I am statecraft; among secret things I am silence; and I am the wisdom of the wise.

sanskrit: yac cāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tad aham arjuna na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
english: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, moving or unmoving, that could exist apart from me.

sanskrit: nānto 'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paraṃtapa eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
english: There is no end to my divine manifestations, O scorcher of foes; what I have declared of the extent of my power is but by way of illustration.

sanskrit: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmad ūrjitam eva vā tat tad evāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃśasaṃbhavam
english: Whatever being possesses power, beauty, or might, know that each has sprung from a fragment of my splendor.

sanskrit: atha vā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna viṣṭabhyāham idaṃ kṛtsnam ekāṃśena sthito jagat
english: But what need have you, O Arjuna, to know all this in detail? With a single fragment of myself I stand supporting this entire world.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyam adhyātmasaṃjñitam yat tvayoktaṃ vacas tena moho 'yaṃ vigato mama
english: Arjuna said: By the supreme and secret word concerning the Self, which out of grace toward me you have spoken, this delusion of mine has been dispelled.

sanskrit: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyam api cāvyayam
english: For the arising and the passing away of beings I have heard from you in full, O lotus-eyed one, and your imperishable majesty as well.

sanskrit: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṃ parameśvara draṣṭum icchāmi te rūpam aiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
english: Even as you have declared yourself to be, O supreme Lord, so it is. Yet I long to behold your sovereign form, O supreme Spirit.

sanskrit: manyase yadi tac chakyaṃ mayā draṣṭum iti prabho yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānam avyayam
english: If you think it possible for me to behold it, O Lord, then, O master of yoga, show me your imperishable Self.

sanskrit: śrībhagavān uvāca paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
english: The Blessed Lord said: Behold my forms, O Pārtha, by the hundreds and by the thousands—manifold and divine, of many colors and many shapes.

sanskrit: paśyādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau marutas tathā bahūny adṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata
english: Behold the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Aśvins, and the Maruts; behold, O descendant of Bharata, many marvels never seen before.

sanskrit: ihaikasthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram mama dehe guḍākeśa yac cānyad draṣṭum icchasi
english: Here, gathered together in one place within my body, behold now the whole world, with all that moves and is unmoving, O Guḍākeśa, and whatever else you wish to see.

sanskrit: na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭum anenaiva svacakṣuṣā divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogam aiśvaram
english: But you cannot behold me with this eye of your own; I give you a divine eye—behold my sovereign yoga.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca evam uktvā tato rājan mahāyogeśvaro hariḥ darśayām āsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpam aiśvaram
english: Saṃjaya said: Having spoken thus, O king, Hari, the great lord of yoga, then revealed to Pārtha his supreme sovereign form—

sanskrit: anekavaktranayanam anekādbhutadarśanam anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
english: with many mouths and eyes, with many wondrous aspects, with many divine ornaments, with many divine weapons raised on high;

sanskrit: divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam sarvāścaryamayaṃ devam anantaṃ viśvatomukham
english: wearing divine garlands and raiment, anointed with divine fragrances—the all-marvelous god, infinite, facing in every direction.

sanskrit: divi sūryasahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
english: If the light of a thousand suns were to blaze forth all at once in the sky, that might resemble the splendor of that great-souled one.

sanskrit: tatraikasthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktam anekadhā apaśyad devadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavas tadā
english: There, gathered together in one place yet divided in manifold ways, the son of Pāṇḍu then beheld the whole world within the body of the god of gods.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanaṃjayaḥ praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata
english: Then Dhanaṃjaya, seized with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowing his head to the god with joined palms, spoke:

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca paśyāmi devāṃs tava deva dehe; sarvāṃs tathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṃghān brahmāṇam īśaṃ kamalāsanastham; ṛṣīṃś ca sarvān uragāṃś ca divyān
english: Arjuna said: I behold within your body, O god, the gods and all the assembled hosts of beings—Brahmā the lord seated upon his lotus throne, and all the seers and the divine serpents.

sanskrit: anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ; paśyāmi tvā sarvato 'nantarūpam nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punas tavādiṃ; paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
english: With many arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes I behold you, infinite of form on every side. I see in you no end, no middle, nor any beginning, O lord of all, O form of all.

sanskrit: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca; tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantād; dīptānalārkadyutim aprameyam
english: Crowned with a diadem, bearing mace and discus, a mass of radiance blazing on every side—I behold you, hard to gaze upon all around, with the brilliance of blazing fire and sun, immeasurable.

sanskrit: tvam akṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ; tvam asya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam tvam avyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā; sanātanas tvaṃ puruṣo mato me
english: You are the supreme Imperishable, the one to be known; you are the highest resting-place of this universe; you are the changeless guardian of the eternal dharma; you are the everlasting Spirit, so I deem you.

sanskrit: anādimadhyāntam anantavīryam; anantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ; svatejasā viśvam idaṃ tapantam
english: Without beginning, middle, or end, of infinite power, with countless arms, the moon and sun your eyes—I behold you, your mouth a blazing sacrificial fire, scorching this universe with your own splendor.

sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivyor idam antaraṃ hi; vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaś ca sarvāḥ dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpam idaṃ tavograṃ; lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
english: This space between heaven and earth, and all the quarters, are pervaded by you alone. Seeing this wondrous and terrible form of yours, the three worlds tremble in anguish, O great-souled one.

sanskrit: amī hi tvā surasaṃghā viśanti; ke cid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti svastīty uktvā maharṣisiddhasaṃghāḥ; stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
english: Yonder hosts of gods enter into you; some, afraid, with joined palms extol you. Crying "Hail!" the throngs of great sages and perfected ones praise you with abundant hymns of praise.

sanskrit: rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā; viśve 'śvinau marutaś coṣmapāś ca gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṃghā; vīkṣante tvā vismitāś caiva sarve
english: The Rudras, the Ādityas, the Vasus, and the Sādhyas, the Viśvedevas, the two Aśvins, the Maruts, and the drinkers of vapor, the hosts of gandharvas, yakṣas, asuras, and siddhas—all gaze upon you, and all are amazed.

sanskrit: rūpaṃ mahat te bahuvaktranetraṃ; mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ; dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham
english: Beholding your mighty form of many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed, of many arms, thighs, and feet, of many bellies, terrible with many fangs, the worlds tremble in anguish, and so do I.

sanskrit: nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptam anekavarṇaṃ; vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā; dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
english: Touching the sky, ablaze, of many hues, with gaping mouths and vast blazing eyes—seeing you thus, my inmost self trembles, and I find neither steadiness nor peace, O Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni; dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasaṃnibhāni diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma; prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
english: Seeing your mouths, terrible with fangs and resembling the fire of universal dissolution, I know not the quarters of the sky, and I find no refuge. Be gracious, O lord of gods, O dwelling-place of the world.

sanskrit: amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ; sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṃghaiḥ bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputras tathāsau; sahāsmadīyair api yodhamukhyaiḥ
english: And yonder, the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, all of them, together with the hosts of kings—Bhīṣma, Droṇa, and that son of the charioteer too—along with our own foremost warriors as well,

sanskrit: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti; daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni ke cid vilagnā daśanāntareṣu; saṃdṛśyante cūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ
english: hastening, they enter your mouths, terrible with fangs and dreadful; some are seen clinging between your teeth, their heads ground to powder.
